definitions.text_en: foal, colt (a preadult horse or ass which has been weaned)
definitions.text_mt: Felh ta' żiemel jew ħmar li niftam u għandu bejn sena u sentejn.

usage_examples.en: The herd had a very beautiful foal.
usage_examples.mt: Il-merħla kellha felu sabiħ ħafna.

usage_examples.en: Do not let it go to your head; this colt still knows nothing.
usage_examples.mt: Tħallix dan jitla'lek rasek, għadek felu u ma taf xejn.

usage_examples.en: That boy is still a colt, he understands nothing of the world.
usage_examples.mt: Dak it-tifel għadu felu, ma jifhem xejn mid-dinja.

definitions.text_mt: Tkabbir żgħir u iebes fil-ġilda kkawżat minn virus.

usage_examples.en: The doctor removed my wart with a laser.
usage_examples.mt: It-tabib neħħieli l-felul b'-laser.

usage_examples.en: There is a good cream for removing verrucas.
usage_examples.mt: Hemm krema tajba għat-tneħħija tal-felul.

definitions.text_mt: Qawwa u enerġija fiżika jew mentali.

usage_examples.en: This man's vigour is extraordinary.
usage_examples.mt: Il-felħ ta' dan ir-raġel huwa straordinarju.

usage_examples.en: With all his vigour, he managed to finish the work.
usage_examples.mt: Bil-felħ kollu tiegħu, irnexxielu jlesti x-xogħol.

usage_examples.en: He is a vigorous man and always ready to help.
usage_examples.mt: Huwa raġel felħan u dejjem lest jgħin.

usage_examples.en: The vigorous horses pulled the cart up the hill.
usage_examples.mt: Iż-żwiemel felħana ġibdu l-karru sa fuq l-għolja.

usage_examples.en: The young man was vigorous and full of strength.
usage_examples.mt: Il-ġuvni kien felħani u mimli saħħa.

usage_examples.en: Vigorous people live a better life.
usage_examples.mt: In-nies felħanin jgħixu ħajja aħjar.

usage_examples.en: He is vigorous and always achieves his goals.
usage_examples.mt: Huwa felħi u dejjem jilħaq l-għanijiet tiegħu.

usage_examples.en: Vigorous plants grow quickly in this soil.
usage_examples.mt: Il-pjanti felħin jikbru malajr f'dan il-ħamrija.

usage_examples.en: The word 'xemx' is of feminine gender in Maltese.
usage_examples.mt: L-isem 'xemx' huwa ta' ġeneru femminil bil-Malti.

usage_examples.en: We are learning the difference between masculine and feminine gender.
usage_examples.mt: Qegħdin nitgħallmu d-differenza bejn il-ġeneru maskili u l-femminil.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nisa jew mal-ġeneru femminili.

usage_examples.en: Feminine characteristics are diverse and unique.
usage_examples.mt: Il-karatteristiċi femminili huma diversi u uniċi.

usage_examples.en: This dress has an elegant feminine design.
usage_examples.mt: Din il-libsa għandha disinn femminili elegant.

definitions.text_mt: Kwalità jew stat li tkun mara jew femminili.

usage_examples.en: Femininity is not defined by appearance alone.
usage_examples.mt: Il-femminilità mhix definita mid-dehra biss.

usage_examples.en: She embraces her femininity with pride.
usage_examples.mt: Hija tħaddan il-femminilità tagħha b'kburija.

usage_examples.en: 'Tifla' is a feminine noun in Maltese.
usage_examples.mt: 'Tifla' hija nom femminin bil-Malti.

usage_examples.en: The feminine gender has specific grammatical rules.
usage_examples.mt: Il-ġeneru femminin għandu regoli grammatikali speċifiċi.

definitions.text_mt: Moviment soċjali u politiku li jippromwovi d-drittijiet tan-nisa u l-ugwaljanza bejn is-sessi.

usage_examples.en: Feminism has helped improve women's rights.
usage_examples.mt: Il-femminiżmu għen biex jitjiebu d-drittijiet tan-nisa.

usage_examples.en: Many women support the feminism movement.
usage_examples.mt: Ħafna nisa jappoġġjaw il-moviment tal-femminiżmu.

usage_examples.en: Feminism promotes equality between the sexes.
usage_examples.mt: Il-femminiżmu jippromwovi l-ugwaljanza bejn is-sessi.

definitions.text_en: to exhaust (somebody), to tire out (especially spiritually)
definitions.text_mt: Tgħejja lil xi ħadd, speċjalment spiritwalment.

usage_examples.en: The exhausting work exhausted Paul.
usage_examples.mt: Ix-xogħol eżawrjenti fena lil Pawlu.

usage_examples.en: Do not let worry exhaust your soul.
usage_examples.mt: Tħallix l-inkwiet jifni ruħek.

usage_examples.en: The long journey tired out the travellers.
usage_examples.mt: Il-vjaġġ twil fiena lill-vjaġġaturi.

definitions.text_en: to interpolate (to introduce something, such as words, between other things, such as other words)
definitions.text_mt: Daħħal kliem jew informazzjoni ġdida f'nofs test jew diskors.

usage_examples.en: The cart trundled down the road.
usage_examples.mt: Il-karru fenda 'l isfel mit-triq.

usage_examples.en: He fended well for himself in the discussion.
usage_examples.mt: Huwa fenda tajjeb għalih innifsu fid-diskussjoni.

usage_examples.en: This business has been profitable in recent years.
usage_examples.mt: Dan in-negozju fenda sew f'dawn l-aħħar snin.

usage_examples.en: The writer interpolated passages from other works.
usage_examples.mt: Il-kittieb fenda siltiet minn xogħlijiet oħra.

usage_examples.en: Mr Fenech lives in the capital city.
usage_examples.mt: Is-Sur Fenech jgħix fil-belt kapitali.

usage_examples.en: The Fenech family has been living in Malta for centuries.
usage_examples.mt: Il-familja Fenech ilha tgħix Malta għal sekli sħaħ.

definitions.text_mt: Mammiferu żgħir tal-familja Leporidae, b'widnejn twal u denb qasir.

usage_examples.en: The rabbit runs away quickly when frightened.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fenek jaħrab malajr meta jibża'.

usage_examples.en: In Malta, the rabbit is a popular animal both as a pet and for food.
usage_examples.mt: F'Malta, il-fenek huwa annimal popolari kemm bħala pet kif ukoll għall-ikel.

usage_examples.en: We saw a wild rabbit in the fields.
usage_examples.mt: Rajna fenek selvaġġ fl-għelieqi.

definitions.text_en: female equivalent of fenek: female rabbit

usage_examples.en: The doe gave birth to five small kits.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fenka welldet ħames ferħat żgħar.

usage_examples.en: My female rabbit has soft white fur.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fenka tiegħi għandha pil artab u abjad.

usage_examples.en: Rabbit stew is a traditional Maltese dish.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fenkata hija platt tradizzjonali Malti.

usage_examples.en: On Sundays, we used to eat rabbit stew in this restaurant.
usage_examples.mt: Nhar il-Ħadd, konna nieklu l-fenkata f'dan ir-ristorant.

usage_examples.en: This restaurant serves the best rabbit stew on the island.
usage_examples.mt: Dan ir-ristorant iservi l-aqwa fenkata fil-gżira.

usage_examples.en: The rabbit hunters gathered in the countryside for the hunt.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fenkuniera iltaqgħu fil-kampanja għall-kaċċa.

usage_examples.en: He was an experienced rabbit hunter who knew every corner of the islands.
usage_examples.mt: Kien fenkunier imħawwar li kien jaf kull rokna tal-gżejjer.

definitions.text_mt: Ħajt jew struttura tal-metall jew tal-injam li tagħlaq jew tipproteġi żona ta' art.

usage_examples.en: The farmer built a fence around his field.
usage_examples.mt: Ir-raħħal bena fens madwar l-għalqa tiegħu.

usage_examples.en: The wooden fence fell after the storm.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fens tal-injam waqa' wara l-maltemp.

etymology_chain.definition: to wound, to injure, to hurt
inflection of feriō: second-person singular present passive indicative / imperative present active infinitive

definitions.text_mt: Tagħmel ħsara fiżika lil xi ħadd, speċjalment b'arma.

usage_examples.en: The broken glass injured Mary.
usage_examples.mt: Il-ħġieġa maqsuma feriet lil Marija.

usage_examples.en: Try not to wound anyone during the fight.
usage_examples.mt: Ipprova ma ferix ħadd waqt il-ġlieda.

usage_examples.en: A harsh word can wound more than a sword.
usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma qawwija tista' tferi aktar minn xabla.

etymology_chain.definition: to differentiate, to distinguish, to divide

definitions.text_en: to pass through something, to split, part, e.g. the sea (of a boat), a crowd (of a person), hair (of a comb)
definitions.text_mt: Għadda minn ġo xi ħaġa, qasam jew fired.

usage_examples.en: The boat parted the sea slowly.
usage_examples.mt: Id-dgħajsa ferqet il-baħar bil-mod.

usage_examples.en: He parted the crowd to get through.
usage_examples.mt: Huwa feraq il-folla biex jgħaddi.

usage_examples.en: The comb parted her hair without difficulty.
usage_examples.mt: Il-moxt feraq xagħarha mingħajr tbatija.

etymology_chain.definition: be delighted, be glad, be happy

definitions.text_mt: Ferraħ lil xi ħadd, għamillu awguri.

usage_examples.en: We rejoiced with you on your joyous occasion.
usage_examples.mt: Ferraħna magħkom fl-okkażjoni ferrieħa tagħkom.

usage_examples.en: I made my mother happy with that beautiful gift.
usage_examples.mt: Ferraħt lil ommi b'dak ir-rigal sabiħ.

usage_examples.en: The parents congratulated their son after he graduated.
usage_examples.mt: Il-ġenituri ferħu lit-tifel tagħhom wara li ggradwa.

usage_examples.en: 'Fergħ' is a dated form of 'fergħa'.
usage_examples.mt: 'Fergħ' hija forma antikwata ta' 'fergħa'.

usage_examples.en: Nowadays 'fergħ' is rarely used instead of 'fergħa'.
usage_examples.mt: Illum il-ġurnata rari jintuża 'fergħ' minflok 'fergħa'.

usage_examples.en: The tree has many branches.
usage_examples.mt: Is-siġra għandha ħafna friegħi.

usage_examples.en: The new subsidiary of the company opened in Malta.
usage_examples.mt: Il-fergħa l-ġdida tal-kumpanija fetħet f'Malta.

usage_examples.en: A bird built its nest on a branch of the tree.
usage_examples.mt: Għasfur bena bejtu fuq fergħa tas-siġra.

usage_examples.en: He does not like it when people act arrogantly in front of him.
usage_examples.mt: Ma jħobbx meta n-nies jifergħnu quddiemu.

usage_examples.en: He sweated and cursed while working in the fields.
usage_examples.mt: Fergħen u għaraq waqt li kien qed jaħdem fl-għelieqi.
